traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Vaccinium (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.62 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 56 records in 8 sources); trunks 0.63, branches 0.6. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.note: Abrams's Illustrated Flora of the Pacific States, volume 3 (1951), read in full: the blueberries and huckleberries, kept by Abrams as Vacciniaceae, with the ovary inferior and the fruit a berry crowned by the calyx (Jepson eFlora's key: ovary inferior, as quoted in search results; the page itself was not read).
